items.title: MetLife (MET) Stock Still Trades Below Fair Value On Earnings Power

items.title: MetLife (MET) Dividend Declaration Keeps Its Undervalued Narrative In Focus

items.title: How Real Estate Debt Fund Close At MetLife (MET) Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: MetLife Investment Management closed US$370 million in equity commitments to its MetLife Opportunistic Real Estate Debt Fund, expanding capacity to provide senior and subordinate loans across U.S. commercial property sectors. The MORE fund adds another fee based, capital light platform alongside MetLife’s insurance and retirement operations, potentially widening sources of revenue beyond traditional spread income.
